clips.title: The story
paras: Agmond's End is an abandoned dwarven excavation site tucked into the southern hills of the Badlands. Once a hopeful exploratory dig led by the prospector Agmond, the camp turned into a slaughterhouse when burrowing troggs overran the operation and killed its leader.

Like many sites in the arid Badlands, Agmond's End began as a dwarven venture to uncover ancient relics and delve into the earth's buried history. That dream ended abruptly when savage troggs surged from the surrounding crevices and overwhelmed the miners. Agmond himself was cut down during the attack, giving the site its grim name. Today, the ruined dig remains utterly infested by Stonevault troggs, with shattered crates and abandoned tools left exactly where they fell.

Near the ruined excavation sits a solitary camp inhabited by Theldurin the Lost, a dwarf whose sanity has long since frayed. He remains one of the few souls willing to brave the southern desert near the doomed site.
